description: Runs a read-only script for questions that describe_plan does not answer, and returns what it returns. Scripts work as in edit_project, but only plan.floors, plan.elements, plan.get, plan.describe, plan.warnings, plan.check and plan.search are available; plan.check("din18040-2") or plan.check("irc2021") checks the plan against DIN 18040-2 for barrier-free dwellings or the 2021 IRC.

project_id.description: The project's ID from list_projects or create_project. Never show it to the person.
